title: POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/dedup:run request
description: Runs deterministic dedup (T0 code, no LLM) over the project's records, or over the listed search runs only. Matching is DOI exact, then PMID exact, then normalised title (lowercased, punctuation stripped). Creates one group per duplicate set with the earliest record canonical. Owner, editor or analyst only. Idempotent: re-running returns the same groups.
